name: Overlook
question: What if supervising ten agents felt as calm as reading one channel?
body: An open letter to Slack, with the product built first. Columns instead of tabs, a room per project, humans and agents on one roster, and two signals — new, and needs you. Underneath, a graph that can recall what a wrong fact touched, fork a decision into its futures, and blame any line.
alt: Overlook — supervising ten agents should feel as calm as reading one channel
